Charlotta wears her hair styled in innumerable plaits. She is also known to wear blue bows.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013)_

## History

Charlotta the Fourth, whose real name is Leonora, worked as a young handmaiden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for her adored mistress, Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). While picking strawberries, she confided her concerns to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency. She later helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit, anxiously waiting in the kitchen until she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saw [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walking together in the garden.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), +12 more_

## Quotes

> “Oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am,” she breathed, “I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> “No, I can understand that,” said Charlotta. “A wedding ain’t poetry. Why, Miss Shirley, ma’am, you’re crying! What for?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlotta.md)

Charlotta first meets [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally gets lost in the woods and arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). As a welcoming presence at the cottage, Charlotta serves tea to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and demonstrates her echoing tin horn. Their relationship develops into a friendly bond as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +6 more_

- Friend of — welcoming guest at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta meets [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lose their way in the woods and find [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Charlotta serves as a welcoming host alongside her mistress, serving tea to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) during her visit. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later returns to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to help prepare the stone house for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +10 more_

- Friend of — welcoming guest at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta works as the young handmaiden and maid for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She assists [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with daily chores, such as serving tea guests and demonstrating the household's echoing tin horn. Charlotta cares deeply for her employer's well-being, growing concerned and speaking up when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) suffers from unusual despondency.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +13 more_

- Serves under — employer of handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +1 more</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Charlotta considers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a trusted friend, admiring her and confiding in her regarding Miss Lavendar's mood and well-being. The two work closely together picking strawberries, preparing [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit, and helping plan Miss Lavendar's wedding. Charlotta frequently visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to offer commentary and share in the excitement surrounding the upcoming marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), +17 more_

- Friend of — admires her and confides in her  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>
